title: 第3章 果断斩杀第4章 杨家
content_zh:
余老经验丰富，陈阳只是稍稍勾动体内灵力，他便有所察觉。
转头间眼中有些不可思议的神采。
“家主！等等！”
杨家主被叫住，也是顺着他的目光看来，就看到了一个圆润光滑的灰石头，静静的躺在树的根部。
“这块石头，可是还有什么玄机？”
“家主，这石头紧挨着四叶衔灵草，我方才已经看过年份，灵草已经成熟许久。”
余老说道。
杨家主闻言立马反应过来。
“书上记载，此灵植每三月诞下一滴灵液，很可能都落在了这块石头上。”
“不错。”
余老点头，上前将陈阳拾起，随后抱着试一试的心态，催动自身灵力灌注进陈阳体内。
唰——
下一刻，周边灵气便有了目标一般，向此地汇聚而来。
“这！”
杨家主半张着嘴巴，表情无比惊讶。
余老更是如获至宝般抚摸着陈阳。
“家主，不会错！这是一块聚灵石！聚气初期级别，而且，只要带回去用灵力好生温养，用不了多久就能提升至聚气中期！”
余老心头大喜，说道：“这小石头也是好运气，身旁长了一株四叶衔灵草，被灵液滋养许久，也成了一件宝贝咯。”
他看出了陈阳的用途，但却搞反了关系，以为是先有了四叶衔灵草，再有了聚灵石。
实际上，这株小灵植，才是陈阳多年聚灵孕育而出的。

也不怪他们猜不到，毕竟诞生了神智能够自行修炼，还能自行发挥作用的灵物，那都只存在于传说当中，根本不是他们这个层次能够接触到的。
余老的话让杨家主心情无比激动，他的双手有些颤抖，小心翼翼的接过陈阳。
“此行获一灵植，又得一灵宝，实乃大幸！我杨家当兴！”
“家主，时间差不多了，我们该快些离去了。”
“没错，迟则生变，我们快走。”
将黑藤木盒与陈阳一同收入袖中，二人立刻朝着来时的方向狂奔。
在杨家主的袖中，陈阳也算是开了眼界。
“乖乖，难怪这袖子要做的这么大。”
里面藏着十张火红的符箓，一个飞刀模样的暗器，还有五颗黑红弹丸。
这些东西都和陈阳一样，被杨家主用自身灵力吸在了袖内，随时都能够发动对敌。
“果然还是起步阶段的小家族，连个储物袋都没有。”
陈阳静静的待在袖内，等待着离开秘境，前往更广阔的天地。
但就在接近出口之时，异变突生。
有三道气息挡住了余老和杨家主的去路。
陈阳放出意识感知，发现这三人修为比杨家二人低几分，但却有着人数的优势。
“哦？竟然有比我们动作还快的，不知得了什么好处。”
“大哥，这二人看着模样，不像是宗门和王朝的修士。”
左右两个青年修士说道。
他们话语间，威胁的意味十分明显。
不是宗门和王朝修士，就代表着没有后台背景，也无人撑腰。

那不就意味着，他们即便死在秘境中也无人会追究。
为首那名光头修士看向杨家二人，双眼微虛，身形未动，灵力却已经悄然运转。
与此同时，待在袖中的陈阳也看到，有六道火红符箓已然蓄势待发。
甚至都没有相互自报家门和拉扯的环节，两方的战斗便瞬间爆发！
杨家主迎向了光头修士，余老则一个闪身，从旁牵制两名青年修士。
content_en:
Mr. Yu is rich in experience, and Chen Yang only noticed it if he stirred up the spiritual power in his body a little.
When he turned around, there was an incredible look in his eyes.
"Master! Wait!"
The head of the Yang family was called to a halt, and following his gaze, he saw a round and smooth gray stone lying quietly at the root of the tree.
"What's the secret behind this stone?"
"Master, this stone is next to the four-leaf spiritual grass. I have just checked the year, and the spiritual grass has been mature for a long time."
Mr. Yu said.
The head of the Yang family reacted immediately after hearing this.
"It is recorded in the book that this spiritual plant gives birth to a drop of spiritual liquid every three months, and it is likely that it all falls on this stone."
"Not bad."
Mr. Yu nodded, stepped forward to pick up Chen Yang, and then with the mentality of giving it a try, he urged his own spiritual power to be poured into Chen Yang's body.
Swish——
The next moment, the surrounding spiritual energy gathered towards this place as if it had a target.
"This!"
The head of the Yang family opened his mouth half-open, his expression extremely surprised.
Mr. Yu even touched Chen Yang as if he had found a treasure.
"Master, you can't be wrong! This is a spirit gathering stone! It's at the early stage of gathering energy. Moreover, as long as you take it back and use your spiritual power to grow and warm it, it won't take long to reach the middle stage of gathering energy!"
Mr. Yu was overjoyed and said, "This little stone is also good luck. There is a four-leaf spiritual grass growing next to it. It has been nourished by the spiritual liquid for a long time and has become a treasure."
He saw Chen Yang's purpose, but he reversed the relationship, thinking that there was the four-leaf spirit grass first, and then the spirit gathering stone.
In fact, this little spiritual plant was bred by Chen Yang after many years of gathering spirits.
It's no wonder that they couldn't guess. After all, there are spiritual beings that can cultivate their own minds and function on their own. Those only exist in legends and are not accessible to them at this level.
Mr. Yu's words made Patriarch Yang extremely excited. His hands were trembling a little as he carefully took Chen Yang.
"It is a great blessing to receive a spiritual plant and a spiritual treasure during this trip! My Yang family is very happy!"
"Master, it's almost time, we should leave as soon as possible."
"That's right, things will change later. Let's leave quickly."
Putting the black vine wooden box and Chen Yang into his sleeves, the two immediately ran in the direction they came from.
In the hands of the Yang Family Master, Chen Yang's horizons were also opened.
"My dear, no wonder these sleeves are made so big."
Hidden inside were ten fiery red talismans, a hidden weapon that looked like a flying knife, and five black and red projectiles.
These things are the same as Chen Yang. The Yang family leader used his own spiritual power to absorb them in his sleeves, and he can launch them against the enemy at any time.
"As expected, it's still a small family in its infancy, and it doesn't even have a storage bag."
Chen Yang stayed quietly in his sleeves, waiting to leave the secret realm and go to a wider world.
But just as they were approaching the exit, a sudden change occurred.
There were three auras blocking the way of Mr. Yu and the Yang family.
Chen Yang released his consciousness and discovered that the cultivation level of these three people was a little lower than that of the two Yang family members, but they had the advantage of numbers.
"Oh? There are actually people who can move faster than us. I don't know what benefits they have gained."
"Brother, these two don't look like monks from the sect or dynasty."
The two young monks on the left and right said.
The threat in their words was very obvious.
Not being a monk from a sect or a dynasty means that he has no background and no one to support him.
Doesn't that mean that even if they die in the secret realm, no one will hold them accountable.
The bald monk at the head looked at the Yang family, his eyes were faint, his body did not move, but his spiritual power was quietly moving.
At the same time, Chen Yang, who was in his sleeves, also saw six fiery red talismans ready to go.
There wasn't even a step of announcing each other's status and pulling each other's back, and the battle between the two parties broke out instantly!
The head of the Yang family faced the bald monk, while Mr. Yu stepped aside and restrained the two young monks.
